name: CoreAnalyticsOverview
intent: An analytics overview page for operations: a dismissible risk banner, a row of KPI cards with trend arrows, ECharts bar charts (performance + workload) and a complaint-type donut, plus interactive contractor and 'recent & important' tables that cross-filter the page on click.
when: An analytics readout of KPIs + charts + prioritized tables on one page
The user needs headline metrics, trend charts, and a drillable list that cross-filter
An operations 'overview' that leans on ECharts and data tables (not a map)
whenNot: A KPI strip + project list + geospatial map -> use the CoreOrgOverview product route or compose the dashboard-page pattern
A single record's fields -> use a Detail page
A master-detail worklist -> use the Task Monitor template

chooseOver.component: Assembling KPI cards + ECharts + tables by hand
chooseOver.because: The Analytics Overview template owns the banner + KPI row + chart stack + cross-filtering tables and their interaction.

notes: promotedFrom: apps/web example (OverviewExamplePage) — reflected as a canonical Core template; the example was removed.
